panels.scene: A farmer stands in his small but beautiful field. The sun shines in the sky above.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν ἀγαθὸς καὶ ἰσχυρὸς ἄνθρωπος.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer is a good and strong person.
panels.imageDescription: A strong man standing in a small field under a bright sun

panels.scene: The farmer digs his field. He spots a large stone in the ground.
panels.greekCaption: σκάπτει τὸν ἀγρόν. βλέπει τὸν μέγαν λίθον.
panels.englishCaption: He digs the field. He sees the large stone.
panels.imageDescription: A farmer digging with a tool, noticing a large rock

panels.scene: He lifts the great stone and carries it out of the field. His strength is on display.
panels.greekCaption: αἴρει τὸν μέγαν λίθον καὶ φέρει. ἰσχυρὸς γάρ ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: He lifts the large stone and carries it. For he is strong.
panels.imageDescription: The farmer carrying a heavy stone, muscles straining

panels.scene: The farmer rests in the field, listening to the river flow. He looks up and gives thanks.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ βίος καλός ἐστιν ὅτι ὁ θεός ἐστιν ἀγαθὸς καὶ πιστός.
panels.englishCaption: Life is good because God is good and faithful.
panels.imageDescription: The farmer resting by a river, looking peacefully at the sky
